name: Plain-tailed Warbling Finch
rangeDescription: Andes of western peru (southern cajamarca to la libertad and eastern ancash)
description: Scarce denizen of high-elevation scrub and woodland in the Andes of northwestern Peru. Quite attractive, with a black mask, white eyebrow and mustache, and chestnut sides.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Rufous-winged Illadopsis
rangeDescription: Senegal to ghana; single record from togo
description: A mid-sized, chunky, drably colored babbler. Has a white throat and pale gray underparts, often with some darker olive-brown on the breast.

name: Marbled Murrelet
rangeDescription: Western aleutian islands and alaska to central california
description: Small seabird that breeds in old-growth evergreen forests, sometimes far from the coast. Often in small flocks on coastal waters, where it dives underwater searching for fish.

name: Sri Lankan Shama
rangeDescription: Sri lanka
description: A thrushlike bird with a long, graduated tail, endemic to Sri Lanka. Males are glossy black above and orange below.

name: Purple-crowned Fairy
rangeDescription: Gulf slope of southeastern mexico to southwestern ecuador (el oro)
description: Flashy, rather large hummingbird of humid tropical lowlands. Favors forest edges, adjacent clearings with scattered trees and flowering bushes, and gardens.

name: Antipodes Parakeet
rangeDescription: Locally in antipodes islands
description: Entirely green parakeet endemic to the subantarctic Antipodes Islands. The largest of New Zealand’s native parakeets.

name: Blue Crane
rangeDescription: Locally in northern namibia, southern zimbabwe and south africa
description: A small, elegant, uniformly blue-gray crane that dwells in open habitats in pairs and variably sized groups. The bulbous head, plain face lacking any naked skin, and lack of contrast in the wings are distinctive.

name: White-throated Tinamou
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia and southern venezuela to northern bolivia and amazonian brazil
description: Secretive chickenlike bird that walks on the ground inside forest. Very plump; looks tailless.

name: Przevalski's Nuthatch
rangeDescription: Western china (qinghai to southern sichuan, southwestern gansu, northeastern tibet, and yunnan)
description: Adorable inhabitant of subalpine coniferous and mixed forests. Plain white face, extended black cap, and orange underparts are distinctive within its range.

name: Saunders's Gull
rangeDescription: Coastal eastern china; winters south korea and southern japan to northern vietnam
description: Elegant, dark-hooded gull, restricted to coastal East Asia. Small but stout-bodied and long-winged, with a dark bill in all plumages.

name: Flightless Steamer-Duck
rangeDescription: Southern south america, from southern chile (north to llanquihue) southward to tierra del fuego
description: A large heavily built duck that is uncommon to fairly common along rocky seacoasts; not found on lakes, unlike Flying Steamer-Duck. Both sexes are steely blue-gray overall, brighter than Flying Steamer-Duck, with a stouter and deeper-based bill.

name: Papuan Harrier
rangeDescription: Central and eastern new guinea
description: A common patroller above reedbeds, flying with wings raised in a shallow V-shape. Adult males are predominantly pale gray with a dark-speckled head, blackish back with pale-edged feathers, and black wingtips.

name: Long-crested Pygmy-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Far southwestern amazonian brazil, adjacent southeastern peru, and far northwestern bolivia
description: Small, tufted flycatcher found locally in lowland rainforest. Perches upright, making quick flights between perches to catch flying insects.

name: Purple-winged Roller
rangeDescription: Sulawesi region, including lembeh, bangka, and manterawu (off northeast), and muna and buton islands (off southeast)
description: A distinctive big-billed bird that is entirely deep purple in color except for a conspicuous sky-blue cap and rump. Juvenile has a duller cap and browner underparts.

name: Ashy-fronted Bulbul
rangeDescription: Southwestern philippines (palawan, culion, and busuanga)
description: A drab medium-sized bird of lowland forest and edge on Palawan and neighboring islands. Dull brown overall with paler brown underparts and a whitish throat and center of the belly.

name: Small Lifou White-eye
rangeDescription: Forest and scrub of lifou (central loyalty islands, new caledonia)
description: A classic small yellowish white-eye with a bold white eyering and whitish flanks. The “boring” white-eye on Lifou.

name: Sao Tome Prinia
rangeDescription: São tomé island (gulf of guinea)
description: An active, slender, unstreaked warbler with a long graduated tail that is sometimes cocked. Gray above and pale below.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Northern Carmine Bee-eater
rangeDescription: Savanna and grassland of sub-saharan africa
description: Large and gorgeous bee-eater with a mostly carmine body, and blue-green head and belly. The central tail feathers are elongated.

name: Yellow-plumed Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Mallee of southern australia (southwestern western australia to central new south wales)
description: Adult birds primarily olive-brown with heavy gray streaking on the underparts. Named after its long, yellow neck feathers.

name: Mongolian Accentor
rangeDescription: Mountains of mongolia and immediately adjacent northern china (ningxia)
description: A very plain accentor of dry, open areas with sparse, scrubby vegetation. Patterning more closely resembles that of a lark or a pipit than another accentor: pale sandy brown all over with a paler belly and a finely streaked back.
